name: Metabolic Disease Involving Other Neurotransmitter Deficiency

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Diagnostic Criteria for Metabolic Neurotransmitter Deficiency Disorders

criteria.description: Presence of progressive neurological symptoms including hypotonia, dystonia, and developmental delay
Abnormal cerebrospinal fluid neurotransmitter metabolite profile indicating deficiency of specific neurotransmitters
Identification of pathogenic variants in genes involved in neurotransmitter synthesis or metabolism
Clinical improvement following neurotransmitter precursor or cofactor supplementation

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: All three major criteria (clinical presentation, biochemical analysis, and genetic testing) must be met for diagnosis.
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Early diagnosis is critical for initiation of targeted therapies to improve neurological outcomes.

searchTerms: low muscle tone with delayed development

laboratory: Low cerebrospinal fluid levels of neurotransmitter metabolites such as homovanillic acid and 5-hydroxyindoleacetic acid
Elevated phenylalanine or other amino acid abnormalities depending on subtype
imaging: Normal or nonspecific brain MRI findings
Occasional cerebral atrophy or delayed myelination
genetic: Pathogenic variants in genes such as GCH1, TH, or SPR involved in neurotransmitter biosynthesis
other: Positive response to neurotransmitter precursor therapy (e.g., L-DOPA, 5-hydroxytryptophan)

distinguishingFeatures: Typical onset in childhood with diurnal fluctuation
Severe hypotonia and autonomic dysfunction in infancy
Profound deficiency of dopamine and serotonin metabolites
Distinct genetic mutations in DDC gene

redFlags: Early onset progressive dystonia with developmental regression
Refractory seizures despite standard antiepileptic therapy
references: Wassenberg T, et al. Guidelines for the diagnosis and treatment of tetrahydrobiopterin deficiencies. Orphanet J Rare Dis. 2010.
Pearson TS, et al. Neurotransmitter disorders: a clinical approach to diagnosis and treatment. Neurol Clin. 2019.
Orphanet: Metabolic disease involving other neurotransmitter deficiency (ORPHA:79219)
